title: Pope Urban II calls for the First Crusade
summary: At the Council of Clermont, Pope Urban II urged Western Christians to march east to help Byzantium and free Jerusalem. The crowd answered with the cry Deus vult.
reason: Byzantine Emperor Alexios I had asked for soldiers against the Seljuks, and the pope also sought to assert papal leadership.
significance: It launched two centuries of crusading wars between Latin Christians and the Muslim world.
